summary.ik_policy: fixed canonical analytic yaw/elbow/wrist branch; alternative branches are not scored
summary.score_definition: guaranteed zero-to-P payload over the finite velocity basis and acceleration box
summary.capacity_model: continuous-rated motor/reducer screening; ideal lossless 1:1 input belts
summary.motor_envelope_assumption: min(rated torque, stall torque * (1 - abs(rpm)/no-load rpm)); max mechanical rpm also enforced; no thermal curve
summary.payload_inertia_model: TCP-centered sphere, radius 10 mm, inertia per kg 4e-5 m2
summary.unknown_reducer_rotating_inertia: omitted; complete reducer case mass on parent
summary.jg_definition: sum of squared normalized gravity torques at required upper payload, fixed pose weights

scope: Finite basis/grid search; this is not a proof of a global design optimum.
